content: A Karpenter node roll deleted the checkout pods before the new nodes were Ready. We had no PodDisruptionBudget.
Add a PDB minAvailable=2 on checkout, and pin Karpenter disruption to `WhenEmpty`. Also page on PDB-blocked evictions.
This is why the Kubernetes migration needed a PDB before the EKS cutover.
Agreed. The outage is the evidence that Karpenter without a PDB is unsafe.
